summary: Resource-state reset with early-out guards. Returns -2 if the object pointer a1 is null, or if the sub-object pointer stored at this+0x1C is null. Otherwise clears three state fields (this+0x8, this+0x14, this+0x18) to 0, writes the sub-object's first dword to 7 or 0 depending on the sub-object condition field at this+0x28, and calls sub_52765A with the sub-object data pointer read at this+0x30, a1 and 0. Returns 0 on success. Called by sub_5179E0 (005179E0) and sub_519019 (00519019).

local_names.this: resource object whose state fields are reset (receiver, a1)
local_names.v1: sub-object pointer loaded from this+0x1C; its first dword receives 7 or 0
local_names.a1: resource object pointer also passed through to sub_52765A

operations.description: Early-out: if a1 (this) is null the function returns -2; packet records the null-check guard
Early-out: load sub-object pointer from this+0x1C; if it is null the function returns -2 (packet guard offset 0x28 maps to this null-check on the pointer read at this+0x1C)
Reset the state counters to 0: this+0x14, this+0x8 and this+0x18 are cleared (write order per raw source)
Set the sub-object first dword (reached through this+0x1C) to 7 when the sub-object condition field at this+0x28 is non-zero, otherwise to 0
Call sub_52765A with the sub-object data pointer read at this+0x30, the resource object a1, and literal 0 as arguments
Return 0 on the success path (or -2 from either guard); invoked by sub_5179E0 (005179E0) and sub_519019 (00519019)
